doc.title: Nancy Wilson — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

chapter: Going to New York and Capitol Records
title: Never signing a contract with John Levy
summary: She says they never signed anything in fifty years; Levy notes a first contract is at the Smithsonian.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Managers, bookers and the business of getting work

blocks.x: We’ll come back to that subject too. What do you remember about – we know that John was impressed. He signed you.

No, we never signed anything, to this day. I don’t remember ever signing anything. I’ve been with him for, what?, 50-some years. If there ever was a contract, it was 50-some years ago and never renewed.
That’s true. There is, actually, on file, at the Smithsonian, a copy of your first management contract.
